answer: Every rider posts a bond tied to one phone's hardware root. One root, one identity. A failed audit slashes the bond. Duplicate trip receipts get caught by replay, so sending the same proof twice earns nothing. That is the courier desk rule: real name, real device, real bond. A farm buys one phone per account and still loses the bond on the first bad audit, so the ember of a fake fleet dies on the marble floor of the audit and the nadir of profit arrives.
